approach: Destination rules live in UrlValidator, which every create already calls: after the self-reference check, the host (lower-cased, trailing dot removed) and each of its parent domains are looked up in the configured blocked domains sets, so www.evil.test matches evil.test but notevil.test does not. Refusals are InvalidUrlException with reason BLOCKED_DOMAIN (400 invalid-url, as today). Moderation: a new abuse package with AdminController (POST /api/v1/admin/links/{code}/flag, behind the existing API key interceptor; only keys named in shortener.abuse.admin-keys, else NotAdminException: 403 forbidden). LinkService.flag sets the new status FLAGGED (Flyway V3 widens the check constraint) and evicts the cache after commit; resolve answers 451 link-unavailable for a flagged row and never caches it.

alternativesConsidered.whyNot: Ruled out in the answers: no external dependency on the create path.

alternativesConsidered.option: A blocklist table with an admin API
alternativesConsidered.whyNot: More than needed now; configuration is reviewed and deployed like code. Can come later.

alternativesConsidered.option: Delete abusive links instead of flagging
alternativesConsidered.whyNot: Deletion is the owner's action and answers 404; 451 tells clients why, and keeps the evidence.

schemaChanges:
ALTER TABLE link DROP CONSTRAINT link_status_check;
ALTER TABLE link ADD CONSTRAINT link_status_check CHECK (status IN ('ACTIVE', 'DELETED', 'FLAGGED'));

components.name: abuse.AbuseProperties
components.responsibility: shortener.abuse.blocked-domains (Set<String>, default empty), shortener.abuse.admin-keys (Set<String> of API key names, default empty). The application starts with the defaults.

components.name: url.UrlValidator
components.responsibility: The blocked domains checks; the existing five-argument constructor stays (no rules).

components.name: link.LinkService / Link / LinkStatus
components.responsibility: flag(code): FLAGGED and cache eviction after commit; resolve throws LinkUnavailableException (451) for FLAGGED.

risks.risk: Constraint change on the link table
risks.mitigation: Small table; the new constraint is a superset of the old one, so every existing row passes.

risks.risk: A flagged link is served from a cache
risks.mitigation: Evict after commit; the 451 is never cached; other instances' L1 bounded by its 5-minute TTL (documented).

risks.risk: A blocklist entry is too broad
risks.mitigation: Exact domain-or-subdomain matching only, never substrings; the list is reviewed like code.

rolloutPlan: Migration V3 runs on startup. Ship with an empty blocklist and no admin keys, then set shortener.abuse.blocked-domains and shortener.abuse.admin-keys per environment. Rollback: redeploy the previous version after unflagging any FLAGGED rows (the old constraint rejects them).
